title: Late-1970s research into ELF and frequency weapons, with Valerie involved

tellings.quote: So that was kind of like the wild west in the in the late '70s there of like I think people trying to figure out what this is, what can be done with it. And he was just like in in the middle of that.

plain: In the late 1970s, the story goes, researchers were scrambling to work out what extremely low frequency radio waves (ELF) and other frequency-based weapons were and what could be done with them, and someone Greg Malatzi names only as Valerie was involved. Malatzi, a researcher, tells Michels it was 'like the wild west' and that the figure he is describing was 'right in the middle of that'. He names no source.
